name: react-vite
description: React 19 + Vite + TypeScript with @apps-in-toss/devtools wired in and the design guide pre-baked (AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md carriers, docs/design-guide.md, src/styles tokens+base, src/components/icons.tsx). --local fallback template for /ait:new (canonical scaffold path: create-ait-app).

app_name.description: Human-readable app name shown in UI / metadata. Default: input verbatim.

package_name.description: npm-compatible package name (kebab-case, lowercase). Default: app_name slugified.

substitute._comment: Files in which {{tokens}} should be replaced. Token-free files are not listed.
